query: Intel segment reorganization what does the DCAI segment include

output.content:
Following Intel’s first-quarter 2025 reorganization, the **Data Center and AI (DCAI)** segment includes the portion of the former **Network and Edge Group (NEX)** integrated into DCAI, alongside Intel’s pre-existing data-center and AI business. [[1]] 

Intel split NEX between **CCG and DCAI** rather than retaining NEX as a separately reported segment; DCAI therefore captures the NEX activities managed with Intel’s data-center/AI operations, while the client-aligned portion moved to CCG. [[1]]

sources.title: Intel Reports First-Quarter 2025 Financial Results :: Intel Corporation (INTC)
